newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria to seek again 26,000 T white/raw sugar.
newsitem.headline: Syria to seek again 26,000 T white/raw sugar.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) on Thursday confirmed that an offer by a French company of 13,000 tonnes of white sugar by mistake gave a price of $297 per tonne, according to traders on Thursday.
They said that GEZA also aborted a tender for the purchase of 13,000 tonnes of raw sugar because the price which also was given by mistake was very high.
The traders said the company, which they did not name, had offered by mistake a price of $297 for white sugar and a price of $357.78 for raw.
The company sent a correction which came over one hour after the closing date and time of the tender and was thus not discussed.
"As GEZA is an official authority it could not reject the price offered for whites although they know that the company would not sell at this price," one trader said.
He said GEZA was expected to issue another tender within a week to replace this one.
The original tender, issued on December 14, called for bids for 13,000 tonnes of whites and 13,000 tonnes of raws for delivery in February.
